$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFHJ (AIP France, chart dated 2026-07-09): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Lyon - Corbas

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD reserved for gliding activity, parachuting, for home based ACFT and service ACFT.
Simultaneous use of both RWY is prohibited.
TKOF or LDG of ACFT is stopped if a glider is lying on the glider RWY, at a distance less than a RWY half width from the limit of both RWY.
ACFT down wind leg: pilot must not overshoot the wooded area of Chapotin (overflight of CHAPOTIN prohibited).
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY and the Parachuting on AD (NR 421): see AIP ENR 5.5.
AEM on AD (NR 9755): see AIP ENR 5.5.
